title: CWP/35343/2025 of NAVIN Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS
text:
Jaspreet Kaur See Bae ae IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB & HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 129 Date of decision: December 22, 2025 NAVIN ...Petitioner Versus STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS ...Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE TRIBHUVAN DAHIYA Present: Mr. Mazlish Khan, Advocate for the petitioner. Ms. Tanushree Gupta, Senior Deputy Advocate General, Haryana. TRIBHUVAN DAHIYA, J. (ORAL) The petition has been filed inter alia seeking a writ of certiorari quashing the order dated 31.10.2025, Annexure P-10, whereby the petitioner’s candidature for the post of Mechanic Motor Vehicle Instructor (Practical) Category no.77, against advertisement 12/2019, has been cancelled.

2. Learned State counsel, on instructions, submits that the Department will pass a fresh order by considering all the facts and circumstances of the petitioner’s case in the light of relevant instructions, after affording an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner, within eight weeks.

3. In view of the statement made, learned counsel for the petitioner has no objection to the petition being disposed of in terms thereof.

4. Ordered accordingly. December 22, 2025 (TRIBHUVAN DAHTYA) frpedk Kaue JUDGE Chandigarh
